scope: Opening 60/180 named positions of main-story 6-11 before battle; full-file CN/EN structural alignment audit.

cn_en_semantic_notes.note: EN contains the spelling Lugmenites; CN clearly means people of Lungmen.

cn_en_semantic_notes.en: there's never anywhere they could've gone
cn_en_semantic_notes.note: CN emphasizes that the refugees have nowhere to go; the Russian follows CN without importing the EN absolute past framing.
Colloquial address used by the Yeti Squad for Patriot; working Russian equivalent added to the glossary.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: 霜星大姊她的身体，已经支撑不了多久了
cn_en_semantic_notes.en: She's growing weak. She can't keep this up for long.
cn_en_semantic_notes.ru: Старшая сестра ФростНова… её тело долго не продержится.
cn_en_semantic_notes.note: CN explicitly foregrounds the condition of FrostNova's body; the Russian follows that wording.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: 只要战斗，就总会战死的。战死在这里，我们都觉得不错。
cn_en_semantic_notes.en: Live by the sword, die by the sword. We're okay with dying in battle.
cn_en_semantic_notes.ru: Раз уж мы сражаемся, рано или поздно кто-нибудь погибнет в бою. Мы не против пасть здесь.
cn_en_semantic_notes.note: The Russian keeps the explicit inevitability of death in battle rather than copying the EN idiom.

cn_en_semantic_notes.cn: 大姊的温度会冷到你受不了
cn_en_semantic_notes.en: Our Sister is far too cold for you.
cn_en_semantic_notes.ru: Без защиты холод старшей сестры тебе не выдержать.
cn_en_semantic_notes.note: CN specifies her temperature; the Russian preserves the warning in context.

cn_en_semantic_notes.en: The Arts have emptied her body.
cn_en_semantic_notes.note: The CN bodily image is retained.

header_title.note: The HEADER payload is identical in CN and EN but appears to conflict with the file suffix _beg. It is retained literally and not used to reorder the scene.

note: The first 60 named positions are a partial literary draft, not a complete scene. The three Decision options and all later dialogue remain untranslated. Structural alignment was checked for the full CN and EN files; the translated range contains 58 command lines. No full CN/EN scripts were committed.
